newsitem.title: USA: UPS board to appoint Alden as vice-chairman.
newsitem.headline: UPS board to appoint Alden as vice-chairman.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America Inc(UPS) said its board of directors has nominated John Alden to become vice-chairman as part of the succession for retiring chairman and chief executive officer Kent (Oz) Nelson.
Alden, 54, currently senior vice-president for business development, will become vice-chairman at the same time that James P. Kelly assumes Nelson's titles. Kelly's promotion was announced last May.
Nelson retires at the end of the year.
The board said Alden will retain responsibility for business development, including marketing, sales, advertising public relations, customer service systems and UPS Logistics Group.

Alden is a career UPS employee, having joined the company 31 years ago. He worked his way up the ranks, mainly through the customer service branch. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
